title: An Update on the Future of Viumo 🚀

blocks.content:
Dear Viumo Family,

We have officially reached our major development milestone, and the app is now fully featured and stable! As our solo developer transitions into a new full-time role, the pace of new feature updates will naturally slow down. 

However, please rest assured: Viumo is NOT going anywhere. The app remains under active maintenance to ensure your streaming stays smooth and uninterrupted.

Viumo has always been a free, passion-driven project. If you love the app and want to support our server costs, any voluntary contributions or tips are deeply appreciated to help keep the platform alive.

🤝 Call to Developers: If you are a developer and want to team up or explore a joint venture to help expand Viumo, we would love to connect!
